# M12-S1: transitive unsafe imports fail under logos, pass allowlisted/warn/allow.
# Plain go runs no audit. Each case uses its own fixture with a
# replace-based dependency so the dep is not a main module.
# RED expectation: cases A, C, F fail red because no audit exists yet,
# so `! logos build` sees a successful build; case E fails red because
# no warning is printed.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Case A: loGo/s main, Go dep importing unsafe, explicit deny -> fail with chain.
cd a/main
! logos build ./...
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/dep'' imports ''unsafe'''
stderr 'example\.com/main/cmd'
stderr '-> example\.com/dep'
stderr '-> unsafe'
stderr 'transitive_unsafe_allowlist'
cd ../..

# Case B: same shape, dep allowlisted -> build passes and runs.
cd b/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/b$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/b$GOEXE
stdout '^42$'
cd ../..

# Case C: Go main, Go dep importing unsafe, explicit deny -> fail with chain.
cd c/main
! logos build ./...
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/cdep'' imports ''unsafe'''
stderr '-> unsafe'
cd ../..

# Case D: plain go runs no audit on the same fixture -> passes.
cd c/main
go build -o $WORK/bin/d$GOEXE ./cmd
cd ../..

# Case E: warn severity -> build passes but prints the warning.
cd e/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/e$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr '\[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\].*example\.com/edep'
cd ../..

# Case F: no logos.toml at all -> deny default -> fail with chain.
cd f/main
! logos build ./...
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/fdep'' imports ''unsafe'''
cd ../..

# Case G: explicit allow -> build passes silently.
cd g/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/g$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr '\[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]'

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/main

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dep"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(dep.Msg()) }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"strconv"
	"unsafe"
)

func Msg() string {
	var x = 42
	return strconv.Itoa(*(*int)(unsafe.Pointer(&x)))
}

-- b/main/go.mod --
module example.com/main

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep => ../dep

-- b/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/dep/**"]

-- b/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dep"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(dep.Msg()) }

-- b/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

-- b/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"strconv"
	"unsafe"
)

func Msg() string {
	var x = 42
	return strconv.Itoa(*(*int)(unsafe.Pointer(&x)))
}
